entries.subject: Size: JPL Small-Body Database diameter
entries.finding: 57 Mnemosyne is drawn as a sphere at the 112.59 ± 2.8 km diameter the JPL Small-Body Database lists, with JPL's stated reference IRAS-A-FPA-3-RDR-IMPS-V6.0. DAMIT held no shape model for it on 2026-10-08, so the sphere is illustrative.

entries.subject: Mnemosyne whole-disc color
entries.finding: Gaia Collaboration, Galluccio et al. (2023) published the mean of 33 Gaia epoch spectra of the unresolved disc: reflectance against the Sun in 16 bands from 374 to 1034 nm, 1 at 550 nm (0.859 at 462 nm, 1.075 at 638 nm). The sphere is painted in that one color (#857f75 in sRGB) through the shared disc-integrated-color method, scaled to the 21.5% geometric albedo JPL lists (± 1.1%), from the IRAS Minor Planet Survey (PDS data set IRAS-A-FPA-3-RDR-IMPS-V6.0). It is one mean, not a map. Tinaut-Ruano et al. (2023), A&A 669, L14, found Gaia DR3 reflectances slightly too red at wavelengths shorter than 550 nm; the bands are used as published, without that paper's correction.
